# Meta-Analysis-of-Freshwater-Beta-Diversity-Change
Data and R scripts supporting a global meta-analysis of directional changes in freshwater β-diversity under anthropogenic impacts.

# Title: Overall Biotic Differentiation Amid Contrasting Freshwater β-Diversity Responses to Human Impacts 

# Author: Vitor M. B. Ferreira

## Repository MAIN structure

* `data/`:
  * `Extraction dataset.xlsx`: dataset used in the main analyses. Use this file with `Bootstrap.R` and `Metaregressions.R`.
  * `lnRR_pairs.xlsx`: effect-size dataset generated by `Bootstrap.R`, containing all paired log response ratios (lnRRs). Use this file with the `Community data.R` to produce the Bootstrap for both presence-absence and quantitative data, as well as Figure 4 of the manuscript.
  * `Coords.xlsx`: geographic-coordinate data used to produce the maps in the figures file.
  * `Titles.xlsx`: titles of the articles included in the meta-analysis.


* `figures/`: contain all the figures of both the manuscript and supplementary material.
  * `spatial_extent_files/`: spatial extents of each sampled region with available spatial information. Article ID (A1, A2...) can be found in `Extraction dataset.xlsx`.
  * `spatial_overla_check/`: cross-check of segregated study cases with available spatial information.


* `scripts/`:
  * `Centroid and Spatial extent calculation.R` was used to calculate the centroid (or midpoint) and the spatial extent (both area      km² and length km) of each sampled region with available spatial information. `Spatial and temporal factors.R` was used to filter the data to run the models of each possible broad-scale confounding factor. Use the `Extraction dataset.xlsx` to run it. `Environmental heterogeneity.R` was used to calculate the climatic heterogeneity of each study case. It needs the bioclimatic variables from WorldClim.
